title: Amnon Violates Tamar
description: Amnon, David's eldest son, falls in love with his half-sister Tamar. Following the advice of his cunning friend Jonadab, he pretends to be ill so that Tamar comes to prepare food for him. He rapes her and then casts her out in shame. Tamar remains alone with her brother Absalom, and the event sows deep hatred within the royal house.
